integrity: Proof and quantified limits are reproduced in RESULT.md; numerical tests corroborate only finitely many cases and are not infinite proofs. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Bounded harmonic functions and L1 boundary distances only; order-sharp rather than best numerical leading constant; not a result about univalent or quasiregular subclasses. Earlier unindexed equivalent stability literature cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Sharp logarithmic stability of the harmonic Hardy coefficient extremizers
